hypothesis: Naming the defect and its remedy in the rule-fail marker (arm B), or adding hand-checkable counts to that (arm C), raises the rate at which reviewers report a planted status upgrade, compared with the shipped marker (arm A).
unit_of_analysis: planted status-upgrade error, clustered by reviewer session (2 planted per session): catches within one reviewer are not independent
decision_rule: adopt a wording only if its 95% Wilson interval lies wholly above the control's, at n >= the minimum per arm, with materials that pass the UTF-8 round trip; overlapping intervals are no evidence
